# Review of the literature

## Summary

The draft describes NASA POWER's monthly temperature at one grid cell, tests for a trend on the training years, and compares a trend-and-season model with naive and seasonal naive forecasts on a hold-out fixed in advance.

## Points to address

1. The draft cites no literature; cite the data source and the methods.
2. Place the trend in regional climate assessments.
